analysis: Nimodipine is a calcium channel blocker specifically indicated for the treatment of subarachnoid hemorrhage. It is used to prevent cerebral vasospasm, a common complication following subarachnoid hemorrhage. While the retrieved information mentions diltiazem as a treatment for subarachnoid hemorrhage, nimodipine is the standard and most widely accepted treatment in clinical practice for this condition.
